title: SM2 private key cannot produce valid signatures
root_cause: OpenSSL treats SM2 keys like normal ECC keys, leading to invalid private keys.
translated_from_cli: openssl pkey -in sm2_bad.key -pubout; openssl pkeyutl -inkey sm2_bad.key -rawin -sign -pkeyopt sm2_id:Alice; openssl pkeyutl -pubin -rawin -verify -pkeyopt sm2_id:Alice
notes: Candidate C harness translated from CLI PoC. Strict reproduction requires the original SM2 private key.
validation_notes: The generated C harness was translated from the original CLI commands involving `openssl pkey` and `openssl pkeyutl` with SM2 id Alice. It compiled and executed using a generated SM2 key and placeholder message. This validates the PKEY/SM2 sign/verify API path, but does not strictly reproduce the original issue because the original sm2_bad.key input has not been recovered.
